entities.summary:
Miles de Noyers was a French diplomat, born in unknown and died on 1350-09-21. He was a key figure in the development of diplomatic practices during the Classical era.

De Noyers was recognized for his innovative approaches to international relations, which earned him a prominent place in the annals of world history. His legacy has shaped the way countries interact with one another, influencing the course of global politics and international law.

As a leading expert in the field of diplomacy, de Noyers' contributions have had a lasting impact on the development of international relations, making him a landmark figure in the history of global politics.

The significance of de Noyers' work can be seen in the many treaties and agreements he facilitated between nations, which have had a lasting impact on the balance of power in Europe and beyond.
